effect_estimate.comment: Purely qualitative thematic study; no statistical or numeric effect estimates are reported, though daily plant treatment volumes (ranging from 0.8 to 43 mL/day) and municipality census demographics are noted descriptively.
effect_estimate.value: Qualitative — no numeric effect estimate reported. Deductive thematic analysis using Ostrom's Institutional Analysis and Development (IAD) framework found that unclear institutional roles, poor stakeholder coordination, weak regulatory oversight, staff education/training gaps, insufficient budgets and chemical supplies (such as chlorine shortages), delayed municipal maintenance of broken equipment and flow meters, insufficient plant capacity, and electricity load-shedding resulted in inconsistent SANS 241:2015 water quality testing, deteriorating water quality, and failure of treatment plants to meet daily community water needs.

mechanism_certainty.comment: Capped at 2 by qualitative study design (CASP Qualitative Checklist).
